author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Fifty-Three! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

MARS: Code Aurora is a miniatures agnostic Warband game for Science Fiction fans, set in the first hours of the colonization of Mars. Five years in a colony ship has caused factions to break down and the splitting of the ark into two as it crash-landed on Martian soil has let loose these different bands of troops to mass conflict. 

Check out the rulebooks in ENGLISH in PHYSICAL HERE: https://www.northstarfigures.com/prod.php?prod=17037

Check out the rulebook in FRENCH in DIGITAL HERE: https://www.wargamevault.com/en/product/555085/mars-code-aurora?affiliate_id=210041
